rules.rule_text: Paraguay caps used passenger-car imports at 10 model-years old from the year of manufacture (motorcycles 5–7 years), under Ley 2018/2002. In 2026 this means roughly model-year 2016 and newer; registered classic cars over 10 years are a limited exception.
rules.source: JP Sheet / Washin Auto (Paraguay import guides)
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Dirección Nacional de Aduanas before purchase.

rules.title: Arancel duty + 10% IVA + fees
rules.rule_text: Vehicle import cost is a stack of the Arancel import duty (0–20% depending on origin and category), 10% IVA on the customs value plus duty, and administrative fees — roughly 28–32% of CIF all-in for a used car. Vehicles never qualify for the duty-free menaje (household-goods) exemption.
rules.notes: Layered Arancel + IVA + fees; exact rate varies by origin. Verify with Dirección Nacional de Aduanas.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty exemption was confirmed for Paraguay in the sources reviewed; EVs are expected to follow the standard Arancel + IVA + fees stack. Confirm EV treatment with Dirección Nacional de Aduanas.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented for used imports — verify with Dirección Nacional de Aduanas.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Angola drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Age limit cited inconsistently (5–6 years)
rules.rule_text: Sources conflict on Angola's used-vehicle age rule: some cite a 5-year prohibition (except diplomats), others a 6-year limit, and others report no strict age limit but high duty. Confirm the current cut-off with Angola Customs (AGT) before sourcing stock.
rules.notes: Sources conflict (5 vs 6 years vs no strict limit) — verify with Angola Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Restricted regime — high duty, Luanda clearance
rules.rule_text: Angola operates a restricted import regime with high duty applied at the port of Luanda; treatment depends on vehicle category and assessed value, and the regime has changed in recent years. Clearance needs standard export documents plus import licence/CNCA where applicable.
rules.notes: High-duty restricted regime — verify current requirements with Angola Customs.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty exemption was confirmed for Angola in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard 30% duty plus 14% VAT (combined ~42–55%). Confirm EV treatment with Angola Customs.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with Angola Customs.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Mozambique drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles — unlike its former colonial power Portugal. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is; source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Enjoy Mozambique

rules.title: No fixed age limit
rules.rule_text: Mozambique currently has no import age limit for used vehicles, making it one of the more accessible markets in Southern Africa — though duty may rise with age and the regime can change. Verify current rules with the Autoridade Tributária (AT).
rules.notes: No age limit today — but confirm with the Autoridade Tributária before sourcing older stock.

rules.title: JUE digital clearance + NUIT + Intertek inspection
rules.rule_text: All vehicle clearance runs through the JUE digital customs portal. A valid NUIT (tax identification number) is required, and the Intertek pre-shipment inspection (MOZ number) is mandatory to avoid heavy fines at Maputo/Beira.
rules.notes: JUE + NUIT + Intertek MOZ — verify the document set with the Autoridade Tributária.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty exemption was confirmed for Mozambique in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the engine-size-based duty plus 17% VAT. Confirm EV treatment with the Autoridade Tributária.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with the Autoridade Tributária.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Uganda drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is; source an RHD export unit.

rules.title: 15-year age limit (13 years proposed for 2026/27)
rules.rule_text: Uganda prohibits the import of passenger vehicles 15 years old or more from manufacture. The government has proposed reducing the limit to 13 years under the 2026/27 Revenue Enhancement and Compliance Measures. In 2026 this means roughly model-year 2011 and newer (trending toward 2013).
rules.notes: 15 years today, 13 proposed — verify the current cut-off with URA before purchase.

rules.title: UNBS inspection + Euro 4/IV emission standard
rules.rule_text: All used cars must pass inspection by the Uganda National Bureau of Standards (UNBS) on arrival and meet the Euro 4/IV emission standard. Uganda is landlocked — vehicles transit via the Port of Mombasa (Kenya).
rules.notes: UNBS inspection + Euro 4; Mombasa transit. Verify with URA before purchase.

rules.title: Environmental levy relief for newer/EV units
rules.rule_text: Uganda's environmental levy on imported vehicles is 0% for vehicles under 9 years old and 50% above 9 years — so newer and EV units avoid the heaviest levy. Confirm current EV treatment with URA.
rules.notes: Environmental levy 0% (<9yr) vs 50% (≥9yr) — verify EV scope with URA.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Tajikistan drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Pre-2013 vehicles banned (Decree No. 355)
rules.rule_text: Under Government Decree No. 355 of 2 August 2023, Tajikistan prohibits the import of any vehicle produced before 2013 — a fixed cutoff, not a rolling window. For 2026 imports only model-year 2013 and newer are permitted.
rules.notes: Fixed 2013 cutoff — verify current enforcement with Tajik Customs.

rules.title: Euro 4 emission standard minimum
rules.rule_text: Imported passenger vehicles must meet the Euro 4 (or higher) emission standard.
rules.notes: Euro 4 minimum — verify with Tajik Customs.

rules.title: EV import-duty exemption (10 years from Oct 2022)
rules.rule_text: To promote EV adoption, Tajikistan has implemented a tax exemption for electric cars, buses and trolleys — including import-duty exemption for a 10-year period starting October 2022. Confirm current EV treatment with Tajik Customs.
rules.notes: EV import-duty exemption (10 years) — verify with Tajik Customs before trading.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Zimbabwe drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is; source an RHD export unit.

rules.title: 10-year age limit (S.I. 54 of 2024)
rules.rule_text: Under S.I. 54 of 2024, motor vehicles aged 10 years and above (from date of manufacture) are prohibited from import into Zimbabwe; S.I. 172 of 2024 permits certain categories to import vehicles 10+ years old. In 2026 this means roughly model-year 2016 and newer for the general channel.
rules.notes: 10-year limit with S.I. 172 exceptions — verify with ZIMRA before purchase.

rules.title: ZIMRA valuation + Durban transit + border clearance
rules.rule_text: Zimbabwe is landlocked; vehicles typically transit via Durban (South Africa) or Beira (Mozambique) and clear at the Beitbridge or Forbes border posts. ZIMRA values the vehicle independently for duty assessment, and pre-export inspection documentation is required.
rules.notes: Durban/Beira transit + ZIMRA valuation. Verify with ZIMRA before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty 25% (hybrid 40%)
rules.rule_text: Zimbabwe's ZIMRA import rules tax electric vehicles at 25% customs duty (hybrids at 40%), with electric tractors duty-free and surtax on older vehicles — a reduced EV rate versus the engine-size ICE schedule. Confirm current rates with ZIMRA.
rules.notes: EV 25% / hybrid 40% — verify current rates with ZIMRA.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Nepal drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles; left-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted for registration. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Park(ing) Day (Nepal import guide)

rules.title: No universal age cap; 20-year operation ban (EV 30-year)
rules.rule_text: Nepal currently has no universal restriction on the age of imported used vehicles, but a 2015 gazette bans the operation of vehicles older than 20 years (extended to 30 years for EVs in 2017). A 2024/25 proposal would restrict import permits to vehicles under one year old by VIN. Verify current import-age rules with the Department of Customs.
rules.source: New Business Age / myRepublica (Nepal age-rule reporting)
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with the Department of Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Customs clearance + Euro 6 emission standard
rules.rule_text: Vehicle imports clear through the Nepal National Single Window (NNSW); imported vehicles must meet emission standards (Euro 6 cited by importer guides). Nepal is landlocked — vehicles arrive via Indian ports (Kolkata/Vizag) or overland via the Tatopani/Rasuwagadhi border with China.
rules.source: Nepal National Single Window / Motar Nepal (import guide)
rules.notes: Landlocked — Kolkata/Vizag transit or China overland. Verify document set with the Department of Customs.

rules.title: EV flat 20% customs duty (FY 2083/84)
rules.rule_text: The FY 2083/84 (2026/27) Finance Bill scrapped Nepal's kW-based EV tax. Imported passenger EVs now pay a flat 20% customs duty, with the old excise duty replaced by a Clean Infrastructure Investment Fee (CIIF) on CIF value, plus a 5% road-construction fee and 13% VAT. Confirm current EV duty with the Department of Customs.
rules.notes: EV 20% flat duty replaces the kW-based schedule — verify current rates with customs.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Zambia drives on the left and accepts only right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: japan-carrier.com (Zambia import regulations) / Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia)

rules.title: No legal age limit; 20% surtax over 5 years old
rules.rule_text: Zambia has no legal age limit on imported used vehicles, but a 20% motor-vehicle surtax applies to vehicles over 5 years old. Duty is age-banded by the ZRA specific-duty schedule. Confirm current surtax with ZRA before sourcing older stock.
rules.source: japan-carrier.com / One Roof Autos (Zambia import guides)
rules.notes: No age ban, but 20% surtax >5 years — verify with ZRA.

rules.title: JEVIC / Bureau Veritas pre-inspection + ZRA specific duty
rules.rule_text: Pre-inspection by JEVIC or Bureau Veritas is mandatory for used vehicles entering Zambia. Zambia is landlocked — vehicles transit via Durban (South Africa) or Dar es Salaam (Tanzania) and clear at a ZRA border post. Duty is assessed on the ZRA specific-duty schedule (flat Kwacha by engine size and age), not a simple percentage.
rules.notes: JEVIC/BV pre-inspection + Durban/Dar transit. Verify document set with ZRA.

rules.title: Hybrid excise 15%; EV treatment not separately documented
rules.rule_text: Zambia applies a reduced 15% excise duty to hybrids; a separate EV import-duty relief was not confirmed in the sources reviewed, and EVs are assessed under the ZRA specific-duty schedule. Confirm current EV/hybrid treatment with ZRA.
rules.notes: Hybrid excise 15%; EV treatment not documented — verify with ZRA.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Laos drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit imports directly without conversion.

rules.title: 5-year age limit removed (2025)
rules.rule_text: Laos removed its strict 5-year age limit on imported used vehicles in 2025, opening a window for 2018–2020 model-year cars. Confirm the current age rule with the Lao PDR Ministry of Industry and Commerce before sourcing stock.
rules.notes: 5-year limit removed in 2025 — confirm current rule with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce.

rules.title: Automatic import licensing + duty by type/age/engine
rules.rule_text: Car imports are subject to an automatic import-licensing regime for statistical/monitoring purposes (Decision on Procedures for Car Import and Distribution). Duties are assessed on vehicle type, age and engine size. Laos is landlocked — vehicles arrive via Thai ports (Laem Chabang) or overland via the China–Laos border.
rules.source: Lao PDR Trade Portal (Decision 74) / Qualitex Trading
rules.notes: Automatic import licence + duty by type/age/engine. Verify with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce.

rules.title: Gas/diesel passenger-import ban (Jun 2024–2026); EV incentives
rules.rule_text: From 1 June 2024 Laos suspended imports of new gasoline- and diesel-powered passenger vehicles (until end-2026), so virtually all newly imported passenger vehicles must be fully electric. The government offers EV tax incentives and imposes no import restrictions on EVs. Confirm current scope with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce.
rules.notes: Gas-car import ban + EV incentives — verify current scope before trading.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Cambodia registers only left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles; right-hand-drive imports face restrictions. China — a pure LHD market — is a natural sourcing base. A China-market LHD unit imports directly without conversion.

rules.title: No hard age cap (as of 2026)
rules.rule_text: Cambodia has no hard used-vehicle age cap as of 2026; proposals to legislate a strict age limit (2024, 2025) were not passed. Vehicles manufactured before 2000 are discouraged due to stricter inspection requirements. Confirm current rule with the GDCE.
rules.notes: No hard cap today, but age-limit proposals recur — verify with GDCE.

rules.title: Euro II emission minimum + Sihanoukville clearance
rules.rule_text: Imported used vehicles must comply with at least Euro II emission standards for inspection. The main seaport is Sihanoukville (Sihanoukville Autonomous Port). Standard export documents plus GDCE customs declaration are required.
rules.notes: Euro II minimum + Sihanoukville clearance. Verify document set with GDCE.

rules.title: EV 0% duty / PHEV 7% (from Jan 2026)
rules.rule_text: Effective 1 January 2026 Cambodia cut customs duty on fully electric passenger vehicles and core EV components from 35% to 0%, and PHEV duty from 35% to 7%. ICE passenger vehicles remain at 35% duty plus 10% VAT. Confirm current rates with GDCE.
rules.source: DFDL / YiJie Auto Sales (2026 Cambodia tariff changes)
rules.notes: EV 0% / PHEV 7% / ICE 35% — verify current rates with GDCE.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Honduras drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles; imports of right-hand-drive vehicles are prohibited. A China-market LHD unit imports directly without conversion.

rules.title: 10-year age limit (Financial Balance & Social Protection Act)
rules.rule_text: Under Honduras' Financial Balance and Social Protection Act, imports of motor vehicles over ten years old are prohibited (except classic collectible cars), and passenger buses over thirteen years are prohibited. Some sources cite a 7-year limit — use the more conservative figure and confirm with a licensed customs broker or the DEI.
rules.notes: 10 years (some sources cite 7) — verify with DEI before sourcing stock.

rules.title: DAI duty + 15% ISV + ecotasa environmental fee
rules.rule_text: Landed cost is set by three lines: the DAI import duty (5–20% by vehicle type under the Central American SAC/CET), the 15% ISV sales tax, and the ecotasa environmental fee banded by vehicle value. The main port is Puerto Cortés. Confirm the current stack with the Dirección Ejecutiva de Ingresos (DEI).
rules.notes: DAI 5-20% + ISV 15% + ecotasa. Verify with DEI.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for Honduras in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard DAI + 15% ISV + ecotasa stack. Confirm EV treatment with the DEI.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with DEI.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: El Salvador drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit imports directly without conversion.

rules.title: 8-year age limit (15 years for trucks/SUVs)
rules.rule_text: El Salvador limits used passenger-car imports to a maximum of 8 years old; trucks and SUVs are limited to 15 years. Vehicles older than these cut-offs may be restricted unless they qualify for an exception (e.g. classic cars). Confirm current limits with the DGA.
rules.notes: 8 years (passenger) / 15 years (trucks/SUVs) — verify with DGA.

rules.title: DUCA clearance + 25-30% duty + 13% VAT
rules.rule_text: Imports clear through the Dirección General de Aduanas (DGA) under the DUCA (Central American single customs declaration). Duty ranges 25–30% of CIF plus 13% VAT (IVA). The main port is Acajutla, reached via Panama transshipment or a Guatemalan/Honduran port plus truck.
rules.notes: DUCA + 25-30% duty + 13% VAT. Verify with DGA.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for El Salvador in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard 25–30% duty plus 13% VAT stack. Confirm EV treatment with the DGA.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with DGA.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Botswana drives on the left and accepts only right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: SUVHUB (Botswana import rules) / Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia)

rules.title: No fixed age limit (duty climbs with age)
rules.rule_text: Botswana has no hard cut-off on the age of imported used vehicles, but duty and taxes are assessed on CIF value and generally climb with age. A 2-year no-sale restriction applies to imported vehicles. Confirm the current BURS schedule before sourcing older stock.
rules.source: SUVHUB (Botswana import rules) / One Roof Autos (Botswana import policy)
rules.notes: No age ban, but tax climbs with age + 2-year no-sale rule — verify with BURS.

rules.title: SACU duty on CIF + import permit (Durban transit)
rules.rule_text: Botswana is landlocked; vehicles arrive via Durban (South Africa) under the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) common external tariff. Duty is assessed on CIF value (customs duty 27% + VAT 12% per importer guides). An import permit from BURS is required. Confirm the document set with BURS.
rules.source: One Roof Autos (Botswana import policy) / SUVHUB
rules.notes: Landlocked — Durban (SA) transit + SACU. Duty 27% + VAT 12% per guides; verify with BURS.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief confirmed
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for Botswana in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard SACU duty + VAT stack. Confirm current EV treatment with BURS.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with BURS.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Namibia drives on the left and accepts only right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: SUVHUB (Namibia import rules) / Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia)

rules.title: Strict 8-year age limit (from first registration)
rules.rule_text: Namibia enforces a strict 8-year age limit on imported used vehicles, counted from the vehicle's first registration date (not model year). An import permit is required before shipping. Source units comfortably inside the 8-year window and confirm with NamRA.
rules.source: SUVHUB (Namibia import rules) / Namibia Trade Portal (second-hand motor vehicle requirements)
rules.notes: 8 years from first registration + import permit — verify with NamRA before sourcing stock.

rules.title: Duty on CIF value + Walvis Bay clearance (NamRA)
rules.rule_text: Duty and taxes are assessed on CIF value (rates vary by engine size, body type and sometimes emissions). The main port is Walvis Bay — a direct deep-water port on the Atlantic coast. NamRA (Namibia Revenue Agency) is the customs authority. Confirm the current duty schedule with NamRA.
rules.source: WalvisLink (2026 vehicle import via Walvis Bay) / SUVHUB
rules.notes: Duty on CIF (varies) + Walvis Bay. Verify document set with NamRA.

rules.title: EV treatment not separately documented
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for Namibia in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard duty + VAT stack. Confirm current EV treatment with NamRA.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with NamRA.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only; LHD not for normal use
rules.rule_text: Mauritius drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles; left-hand-drive vehicles are not permitted for normal use. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: KMC Japan (Mauritius import guide) / Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia)

rules.title: Tight age cap (~3–4 years, set by Finance Act)
rules.rule_text: Mauritius caps used-car imports at a short maximum age — historically around 3–4 years from first registration/manufacture, set by the Finance Act in force and adjusted in each budget. Confirm the current MRA age rule in writing before bidding; LHD is not permitted.
rules.source: KMC Japan (Mauritius import guide) / Expat Mauritius (customs & taxes 2026)
rules.notes: ~3–4 years, moves with the budget — verify the current Finance Act age with MRA before purchase.

rules.title: Excise + VAT on CIF + MRA/NLTA clearance
rules.rule_text: Landed cost is dominated by excise duty plus 15% VAT on importation (MRA tariff). Vehicles discharge at Port Louis and require MRA customs clearance plus an NLTA roadworthiness inspection. Confirm the document set with MRA.
rules.source: KMC Japan (Mauritius import guide) / Expat Mauritius
rules.notes: Excise + 15% VAT, Port Louis, MRA + NLTA. Verify with MRA.

rules.title: EV/hybrid excise concessions (confirm with MRA)
rules.rule_text: Mauritius has historically offered reduced excise for electric and hybrid vehicles under successive Finance Acts. A current, specific EV duty rate was not confirmed in the sources reviewed — confirm the current EV/hybrid excise treatment with MRA.
rules.notes: EV/hybrid excise concessions — verify the current rate with MRA.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Jamaica drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Trade Board Limited (Jamaica)

rules.title: Age limit: 6 years (cars/SUVs), 10 years (pickups/vans)
rules.rule_text: Under Jamaica's Motor Vehicle Import Policy (Ministry Paper #36/14), cars, sedans, station wagons and SUVs (≤8 seats) are limited to 6 years old; pick-up trucks, panel vans and small buses are limited to 10 years. Confirm the current schedule with the Trade Board / Jamaica Customs Agency.
rules.source: Trade Board Limited (Jamaica) — Motor Vehicle Age Limit (Ministry Paper #36/14)
rules.notes: 6 years (cars/SUVs) / 10 years (pickups/vans) — verify with the Trade Board.

rules.title: Import permit (2 vehicles / 3 years) + Kingston clearance
rules.rule_text: Individuals may import up to two vehicles every three years under a Motor Vehicle Import Permit from the Trade Board (resident status applies). Vehicles clear through Kingston via the Jamaica Customs Agency. Confirm the permit and document set with the Trade Board.
rules.source: Trade Board Limited (Jamaica) — Motor Vehicle General
rules.notes: Import permit (2 vehicles/3 years for individuals) + Kingston. Verify with the Trade Board.

rules.title: EV duty concessions (reduced duty)
rules.rule_text: Jamaica offers reduced import duty for electric vehicles (and, previously, hybrids) to encourage EV adoption, and continues to build public charging. Confirm the current EV duty rate and any age/eligibility carve-outs with the Jamaica Customs Agency.
rules.source: Jamaica Customs Agency / Trade Board Limited (EV policy reporting)
rules.notes: EV duty concessions — verify current rate with the Jamaica Customs Agency.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Trinidad & Tobago drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Pace Motors Thailand (2026 Trinidad import regulations) / Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia)

rules.title: Age limit: 6 years (private cars), 10 years (LCV) from Jan 2026
rules.rule_text: Effective 1 January 2026, Trinidad & Tobago extended its used-vehicle age limits: private cars (SUVs, sedans, station wagons) may now be imported up to 6 years old (previously 3), and light commercial vehicles up to 10 years (previously 7). Some categories are 8 years. Confirm the exact category cut-off with the Customs & Excise Division.
rules.source: Pace Motors Thailand (2026 Trinidad import regulations)
rules.notes: 6yr cars / 10yr LCV from Jan 2026 — verify category cut-offs with the Customs & Excise Division.

rules.title: 20–30% duty + MVT + 12.5% VAT (Port of Spain)
rules.rule_text: Landed cost is set by import duty (typically 20–30% of CIF), a Motor Vehicle Tax (MVT) banded by engine capacity, and 12.5% VAT on the duty-inclusive value. Vehicles clear at Port of Spain. Confirm the current stack with the Customs & Excise Division.
rules.source: Pace Motors Thailand (2026 Trinidad import regulations)
rules.notes: 20–30% duty + MVT (engine) + 12.5% VAT. Verify with the Customs & Excise Division.

rules.title: EV/hybrid eligibility tightened; no clear relief
rules.rule_text: Trinidad & Tobago tightened eligibility rules for hybrid and electric vehicle imports under the 2026 Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act amendments; no clear EV duty relief was confirmed. Confirm current EV treatment with the Customs & Excise Division.
rules.source: Pace Motors Thailand (2026 Trinidad import regulations)
rules.notes: EV/hybrid eligibility tightened — verify with the Customs & Excise Division.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) required; LHD re-export only
rules.rule_text: Brunei Darussalam drives on the left. Right-hand-drive vehicles are permitted; left-hand-drive vehicles are allowed only for temporary tour use and must be re-exported. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Washin Auto (Brunei import guide) / Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia)

rules.title: Age limit: 3 years private (4 from manufacture)
rules.rule_text: Imported used vehicles for private use must be no more than 3 years old from original registration and no more than 4 years from the year of manufacture; commercial vehicles are limited to 60 months / 6 years. Confirm the current rule with the Royal Customs and Excise Department (RCED).
rules.notes: 3yr private / 60-month commercial — verify with RCED.

rules.title: Import + excise duty (no VAT) + Muara clearance
rules.rule_text: Brunei levies import and excise duties on vehicles but has no VAT. Used vehicles require an approval permit before departure and a pre-delivery inspection at origin. The main port is Muara. Confirm the document set with RCED.
rules.source: Washin Auto (Brunei import guide) / Expat Focus (Brunei car import)
rules.notes: Import+excise, no VAT, Muara. Approval permit before departure. Verify with RCED.

rules.title: EV treatment not separately documented
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for Brunei in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard import + excise duty structure (no VAT). Confirm current EV treatment with RCED.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with RCED.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Fiji drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.

rules.title: Age limit: ~8 years (has changed recently)
rules.rule_text: Fiji caps used passenger-vehicle imports by age — currently around 8 years for petrol/diesel vehicles (sources cite 2018-or-newer for 2026), though the limit has been adjusted in recent budgets. Confirm the current cut-off with the Fiji Revenue and Customs Service (FRCS) before sourcing stock.
rules.notes: ~8 years, has changed recently — verify with FRCS.

rules.title: Import duty + VAT + Suva clearance
rules.rule_text: Fiji levies import (fiscal) duty plus VAT on vehicles, with an environment levy on some categories. The principal entry port is Suva (Lautoka is secondary). FRCS is the customs authority. Confirm the document set and current rates with FRCS.
rules.notes: Duty + VAT + environment levy; Suva/Lautoka. Verify with FRCS.

rules.title: EV duty concessions (confirm with FRCS)
rules.rule_text: Fiji has offered import-duty concessions for electric and hybrid vehicles to encourage adoption, alongside a growing charging network. A current, specific EV duty rate was not confirmed in the sources reviewed — confirm the current EV treatment with FRCS.
rules.source: FRCS / reliable import guides (EV policy reporting)
rules.notes: EV duty concessions — verify current rate with FRCS.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Papua New Guinea drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / PNG Customs Service

rules.title: No universal age limit (roadworthiness)
rules.rule_text: Papua New Guinea does not apply a single fixed age cut-off to used-vehicle imports; vehicles must meet roadworthiness and inspection requirements (SGS pre-shipment inspection applies to some categories). Confirm any age or condition limits with the PNG Customs Service before sourcing stock.
rules.source: PNG Customs Service (Importing a Used Vehicle) / SUVHUB
rules.notes: No fixed age cap; roadworthiness + SGS inspection. Verify with PNG Customs.

rules.title: Import duty + GST + Lae/Port Moresby clearance
rules.rule_text: Papua New Guinea levies import duty plus 10% GST on vehicles. The main ports are Lae and Port Moresby. PNG Customs Service is the customs authority. Confirm the document set (import permit, inspection) with PNG Customs.
rules.source: PNG Customs Service / SUVHUB (PNG import rules)
rules.notes: Duty + 10% GST; Lae/Port Moresby. Verify with PNG Customs.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief confirmed
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for Papua New Guinea in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard import duty + 10% GST structure. Confirm current EV treatment with PNG Customs.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with PNG Customs.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Guyana drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Guyana Revenue Authority

rules.title: Age limit: 8 years
rules.rule_text: Guyana restricts the importation of vehicles more than 8 years old (the Guyana Revenue Authority publishes this under its 'Vehicles 8 Years Old & Used Tyres' guidance). Source units inside the 8-year window and confirm the exact cut-off date with the GRA before shipping.
rules.source: Guyana Revenue Authority (GRA) — Vehicles 8 Years Old & Used Tyres
rules.notes: 8 years — verify exact cut-off with GRA.

rules.title: Duty (engine-banded) + VAT + Georgetown clearance
rules.rule_text: Guyana assesses motor-vehicle duty by engine size (see the GRA Motor Vehicle Duty/Tax Calculation Guide) plus VAT, clearing through Georgetown. GRA is the customs and tax authority. Confirm the current duty band and document set with GRA.
rules.source: Guyana Revenue Authority — Motor Vehicle Duty/Tax Calculation Guide
rules.notes: Duty by engine cc + VAT; Georgetown. Verify with GRA.

rules.title: EV duty concessions (confirm with GRA)
rules.rule_text: Guyana has offered reduced or zero-rated import duty for electric vehicles in recent budgets to encourage adoption. A current, specific EV duty rate was not confirmed in the sources reviewed — confirm current EV treatment with the GRA.
rules.source: Guyana Revenue Authority / reliable import guides (EV policy reporting)
rules.notes: EV duty concessions — verify current rate with GRA.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Timor-Leste drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Timor-Leste Customs Authority

rules.title: Age limit not clearly documented
rules.rule_text: A single, current used-vehicle age limit for Timor-Leste was not confirmed in the sources reviewed. Confirm any age or condition limits with the Timor-Leste Customs Authority before sourcing stock.
rules.source: Needs verification (no authoritative age rule located)
rules.notes: Age limit not documented — verify with Timor-Leste Customs.

rules.title: Import duty + Dili clearance
rules.rule_text: Timor-Leste levies import duty and tax on vehicles, clearing through the port of Dili. The Timor-Leste Customs Authority administers import procedures under its Laws, Procedures & Regulations framework. Confirm the document set and current rates with the Customs Authority.
rules.source: Timor-Leste Customs Authority — Laws, Procedures & Regulations
rules.notes: Duty + tax; Dili. Verify with Timor-Leste Customs.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief confirmed
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was confirmed for Timor-Leste in the sources reviewed; EVs follow the standard import duty + tax structure. Confirm current EV treatment with the Customs Authority.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented — verify with Timor-Leste Customs.

rules.title: Left-hand-drive traffic, but RHD imports widespread
rules.rule_text: Myanmar drives on the right (left-hand-drive traffic), but a large share of the used-vehicle fleet is right-hand drive (RHD) imported from Japan. Import rules for RHD units have varied over time — confirm the current drive-side requirement with the Ministry of Commerce before sourcing stock.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / DFDL (Myanmar 2025 vehicle import policies)
rules.notes: Official traffic is LHD (drives right), but RHD imports are common — verify current drive-side rule with MOC.

rules.title: Model-year limits set by annual MOC notification
rules.rule_text: Myanmar restricts vehicle imports by model year via an annual Ministry of Commerce (MOC) notification. The 2025 Vehicle Import Policy (issued 4 December 2024) reaffirmed the existing permitted model years. Confirm the current permitted model years with MOC before sourcing stock.
rules.source: DFDL — Myanmar 2025 Vehicle Import Policies (MOC notification)
rules.notes: Model-year limits via annual MOC notification — verify current permitted years.

rules.title: Import permit + duty + Yangon clearance
rules.rule_text: Myanmar requires an import permit/licence and levies import duty plus commercial tax on vehicles, clearing mainly through Yangon (Thilawa). The Customs Department and Ministry of Commerce administer import procedures. Confirm the permit and document set before trading.
rules.notes: Import permit + duty + commercial tax; Yangon (Thilawa). Verify with Myanmar Customs / MOC.

rules.title: EV import concessions (confirm with MOC)
rules.rule_text: Myanmar has reduced import duties and relaxed rules for electric vehicles to encourage adoption, though exact current rates were not confirmed in the sources reviewed. Confirm current EV treatment with the Ministry of Commerce before trading.
rules.source: DFDL (Myanmar 2025 vehicle import policies) / Myanmar Customs
rules.notes: EV import concessions — verify current rate with MOC.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Rwanda registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles only. Right-hand-drive (RHD) units are permitted only for a temporary period (about two weeks) before they must be converted to LHD or re-exported. A China-market LHD unit is registrable as-is.
rules.source: Rwanda Revenue Authority / Automag.rw (2026 import rules)
rules.notes: LHD only; RHD restricted to temporary use. Verify with RRA.

rules.title: No fixed age limit — Euro 4 emissions compliance
rules.rule_text: Rwanda has no fixed vehicle age limit; eligibility is driven by Euro 4/IV emissions compliance (EAC standard EAS 1047:2022). Vehicles manufactured after about January 2006 generally comply, but any unit failing emissions is rejected regardless of age. A certificate of conformity or logbook stating Euro 4 compliance is submitted via the Rwanda Electronic Single Window (ReSW).
rules.notes: No age limit; Euro 4 emissions is the filter. Verify with RRA/RSB.

rules.title: ReSW single window + RSB inspection
rules.rule_text: Rwanda digitised vehicle import clearance through the Rwanda Electronic Single Window (ReSW), which centralises pre-verification of conformity (PVoC), duty calculation and compliance checks. The Rwanda Standards Board (RSB) performs a physical inspection, and importers submit the Euro 4 certificate and proof of CIF value on the platform before shipping.
rules.source: Automag.rw (Rwanda 2026 import rules) / Rwanda Revenue Authority
rules.notes: ReSW + RSB physical inspection; PVoC. Verify with RRA.

rules.title: EV full tax exemption until June 30 2028
rules.rule_text: Fully electric vehicles are exempt from VAT, customs duties, excise duty and withholding tax until June 30 2028 (effective July 1 2025), including charging equipment, batteries and spare parts. Hybrid vehicles lost their full exemption from July 2025 and now pay 18% VAT plus a tiered excise (5% for 0–3 years, 10% for 3–8 years, 15% for over 8 years) while retaining the 25% import-duty exemption. The EV incentives are reviewed annually.
rules.source: EV24.africa / Rwanda Ministry of Finance (revised EV & hybrid tax incentives)
rules.notes: EV full exemption until 2028-06-30; hybrids tiered from 2025-07-01. Verify with RRA.

rules.title: Euro 4/IV emissions standard (EAS 1047:2022)
rules.rule_text: All imported vehicles must meet Euro 4/IV equivalent emissions standards aligned with the East African Community standard EAS 1047:2022: petrol vehicles below 1.0 g/km CO and 0.08 g/km NOx, with stricter diesel limits including a 0.025 g/km particulate-matter cap.
rules.notes: Euro 4/IV (EAS 1047:2022). Verify with RSB.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Malawi drives on the left and permits only right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles (special-purpose vehicles such as ambulances and fire engines are excepted). A China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is — source an RHD export unit.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Carbarn Malawi (import rules)

rules.title: No age limit for EVs; ~10 years for combustion
rules.rule_text: Malawi applies no age limit to imported electric vehicles under the 2025 EV rules, while combustion used-vehicle imports are reported as limited to about 10 years. A mandatory pre-shipment condition appraisal by an approved inspection body is part of the document set. Confirm the current age rules for each powertrain with the Malawi Revenue Authority (MRA) before sourcing stock.
rules.source: Carbarn Malawi (import rules) / EV24.africa (Malawi EV Import Regulations 2025)
rules.notes: EVs: no age limit. Combustion: ~10-year cap reported. Verify with MRA.

rules.title: Duty + excise + VAT, cleared via Dar es Salaam transit
rules.rule_text: Malawi is landlocked; vehicles are shipped to Dar es Salaam (Tanzania) by RoRo and transported onward by road. Duties and taxes are based on engine and seating capacity, and the document set includes the export certificate, original invoice, pre-shipment inspection certificate, bill of lading and condition report. MRA is the customs authority.
rules.notes: Via Dar es Salaam transit; RoRo. Verify with MRA.

rules.title: EV duty exemption (2025): 0% duty + 8% VAT + excise-free
rules.rule_text: Malawi's 2025 EV import rules exempt fully electric vehicles (not hybrids) from import duty, reduce VAT on EVs to 8% (down from 16.5%), waive excise tax for EVs under 100 kW, and apply no age limit to EVs (combustion vehicles are limited to about 10 years). Hybrids receive a reduced excise scale (0% under 8 years, 35% 8–12 years, 60% over 12 years). Charging ports are expected to be Type 2 or CCS. Confirm current figures with the Malawi Revenue Authority (MRA) before trading.
rules.source: EV24.africa (Malawi EV Import Regulations 2025) / BRT Automobile (Malawi EV tariff)
rules.notes: 0% duty + 8% VAT + excise-free (<100 kW) for full EVs; no EV age limit. Verify with MRA.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD)
rules.rule_text: Albania drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit is registrable as-is.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Albanian Customs (DPD)

rules.title: Age limit ~10 years + Euro 4/5 emissions
rules.rule_text: Albania restricts used-vehicle imports to about 10 years of age, with a reported tightening trend, plus a Euro 4/5 emissions requirement. Confirm the current age cut-off and emissions standard with the Albanian General Directorate of Customs (DPD) before sourcing stock.
rules.source: EncarExport (2026 used-car import age limits) / Euronews Albania reporting
rules.notes: ~10 years, tightening reported. Verify with DPD.

rules.title: ASYCUDA World declaration + NIPT
rules.rule_text: Albanian customs clearance is administered by the General Directorate of Customs (DPD) through the ASYCUDA World electronic declaration system. Commercial imports require an Albanian NIPT (business tax ID); personal imports use an Albanian ID or passport. Imports follow the Stabilisation and Association Agreement (SAA) alignment with EU customs procedures.
rules.notes: ASYCUDA World; NIPT for commercial imports. Verify with DPD.

rules.title: EV VAT exemption (new vehicles only)
rules.rule_text: Albania exempts from VAT the import and first domestic supply of NEW electric vehicles (zero kilometres, never previously registered in any country) under Article 51(p) of the VAT Law. The exemption does NOT apply to used electric vehicles — subsequent supplies of used EVs follow the general VAT regime (with the margin scheme available to taxable dealers). So used EV imports attract full VAT.
rules.source: Altax.al (VAT treatment of EVs in Albania) — Article 51(p) VAT Law
rules.notes: EV VAT exemption is new-vehicle-only; used EVs pay full VAT. Verify with DPD.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD)
rules.rule_text: Moldova drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. A China-market LHD unit is registrable as-is.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Customs Service of Moldova

rules.title: No age limit (since Jan 1 2021)
rules.rule_text: Moldova lifted its 10-year vehicle age ban effective January 1 2021; cars can now be imported without an age limit. Excise duty is charged based on engine type, cylinder capacity and year of manufacture.
rules.source: Rapidasig.md (Moldova car excise) / Customs Service of Moldova
rules.notes: No age limit since 2021. Verify with the Customs Service.

rules.title: Excise + VAT, cleared via Giurgiulesti
rules.rule_text: Moldova clears vehicle imports at the Danube port of Giurgiulesti. Declarations must be submitted in writing or electronically within 72 hours of import. Excise duty is applied by engine type, displacement and age, with a customs procedures fee (0.4%, capped at EUR 1,800) included in the VAT base.
rules.notes: Giurgiulesti port; 72-hour declaration. Verify with the Customs Service.

rules.title: EVs excise-free (no engine displacement)
rules.rule_text: Moldovan excise duty is keyed to engine displacement, so electric vehicles (no engine displacement) are excise-free. From January 1 2027 (under the draft fiscal policy), EVs pay only 20% VAT plus the 0.4% customs procedures fee; before 2027 imported cars are VAT-exempt. Confirm the current VAT treatment for EVs with the Customs Service.
rules.notes: EVs excise-free; VAT 20% from 2027 (draft). Verify with the Customs Service.
